info.description: Domain intelligence API — check availability, WHOIS/RDAP data, and DNS records.
info.title: Norcube DomainRadar API

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated, filterable list of brand monitor hits.
Returns details of a single CT certificate hit including AI analysis.
Returns all watchers for the organization.

post.description: Adds a keyword to monitor in Certificate Transparency logs.

delete.description: Removes a watcher and all associated hits.

get.description: Returns a single watcher by ID.
Returns a cursor-paginated, filterable list of hits for a specific watcher.
Returns the total number of CT hits for a specific watcher.

post.description: Checks domain availability using the specified mode.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of bulk check jobs for the authenticated organization.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous bulk domain check job with a specified mode.

delete.description: Deletes a bulk check job, cancels pending queue items, and removes all results (cascade).

get.description: Returns the current state of a bulk check job.

post.description: Removes all pending queue items and marks the job as cancelled.

get.description: Streams every domain check result for a bulk job as a CSV file. Honors the same filters as /results so the export matches the current dashboard view.
get.summary: Export bulk check results as CSV

get.description: Returns cursor-paginated results for a bulk check job.
Opens a Server-Sent Events stream for a bulk check job.

200.description: SSE data events with check results

get.summary: Stream bulk check results via SSE

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of saved domains with latest check data.

post.description: Saves (stars) a domain for the organization.

delete.description: Removes a domain from the organization's saved list.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of name generation jobs for the authenticated organization.

post.description: Creates an async job that uses AI to generate brandable domain name candidates from a description, category, and style.

delete.description: Deletes a name generation job and all its generated names (cascade).

get.description: Returns the details of a specific name generation job including status and configuration.

post.description: Creates a bulk check job from generated names. If names is empty, all generated names from the job are used. Each name is combined with each TLD to produce the domain list.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of generated domain name candidates. Supports regex search via the search parameter (e.g. ^cloud, hub$, ^cl.*od$).
get.summary: List generated names for a job
